dedupe_keys.name: common transmission infrastructure cti sites and private fm radio channels in india

description: This dataset, compiled by Mohit Dhanjani and published on Harvard Dataverse in May 2024, lists the Common Transmission Infrastructure (CTI) sites across India, the shared towers and transmitters from which commercial private FM radio stations broadcast, with the geographic coordinates of each site and the private FM channels on it, their frequencies and other details. The author obtained the list of CTI sites and addresses from Broadcast Engineering Consultants India Ltd. (BECIL) through a Right to Information request, geocoded each address with Google Maps, merged the sites with the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting list of operational private FM channels as of 15 August 2022, and added city categories from the FM Radio Phase III policy guidelines. Coverage: all of India, private FM, 2022. Format and access: tabular files on Harvard Dataverse, free of charge under the Dataverse default terms. Caveats: coordinates are geocoded from addresses, not surveyed; public broadcaster (All India Radio) transmitters are not included; a 2022 snapshot. Simulation uses: an inventory of broadcast transmitter sites for hazard exposure of emergency broadcasting to cyclones, floods and earthquakes, and for coverage and resilience studies. Related records: the Ofcom broadcast transmitter parameters and FCC licence data are counterparts elsewhere.
